name: PROJECT_NAME
description: Monorepo: Astro frontend, Strapi CMS, decoupled API layer

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/cms-strapi -w packages/strapi-kit
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev:cms: npm run build:packages && npm run develop --workspace apps/cms
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:cms: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace apps/cms
